requirement.description: The pypeln package is missing the sync module that is referenced in many test cases. Tests like test_worker_info, test_error_handling, and others are failing because pl.sync is not available.
requirement.contract: Add a sync module to the pypeln package that exposes the same API as thread, process, and task modules for synchronous operations.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_sync.py::test_worker_info, tests/test_sync.py::test_error_handling, tests/test_sync.py::test_map_id, tests/test_sync.py::test_concat_multiple, tests/test_sync.py::test_flat_map_square_workers, tests/test_sync.py::test_from_to_iterable_pipe, tests/test_sync.py::test_from_to_iterable_simple, tests/test_sync.py::test_concat_basic, tests/test_sync.py::test_map_square, tests/test_sync.py::test_from_to_iterable, tests/test_sync.py::test_map_square_event_end, tests/test_sync.py::test_map_id_pipe, tests/test_sync.py::test_flat_map_square, tests/test_sync.py::test_kwargs, tests/test_sync.py::test_flat_map_square_filter_workers, tests/test_sync.py::test_map_square_event_start, tests/test_sync.py::test_flat_map_square_filter_workers_pipe
